title: Signed Arithmetic [imul, idiv, neg]
description:
## Signed vs Unsigned
You know `add` and `sub`. But `mul` and `div` only work with unsigned numbers. For signed (negative) numbers:

- `imul rax, rbx` - signed multiply (result in rax)
- `idiv rbx` - signed divide (rax / rbx, quotient in rax, remainder in rdx)
- `neg rax` - flips the sign (positive becomes negative, negative becomes positive)

**Important for idiv:**
Before `idiv`, you must sign-extend `rax` into `rdx:rax` using `cqo`:
```asm
mov rax, -15
cqo              ; sign-extends rax into rdx
mov rbx, 4
idiv rbx         ; rax = -3, rdx = -3 (remainder)
```

---
## Assignment:
LHINX needs a temperature converter. Write a function `to_celsius` that takes Fahrenheit in `rdi` and returns Celsius in `rax`.

Formula: `(F - 32) * 5 / 9`
setupCode:
section .data
    pass_msg db "PASS", 10
    pass_len equ $ - pass_msg
    fail_msg db "FAIL", 10
    fail_len equ $ - fail_msg

section .text
    global _start
runHarness:
_start:
    mov rdi, 212
    call to_celsius
    cmp rax, 100
    jne .fail
    mov rdi, 32
    call to_celsius
    cmp rax, 0
    jne .fail
    mov rdi, 72
    call to_celsius
    cmp rax, 22
    jne .fail
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, pass_msg
    mov rdx, pass_len
    syscall
    jmp .exit
.fail:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, fail_msg
    mov rdx, fail_len
    syscall
.exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
